data.title: UNHCR urges support  after Venezuela quake

data.description: It is a pity that World Cup final will probably be remembered more for the longest half-time ever than the football squeezed in either side of it. data.title: French holiday haven becomes a disaster zone
data.description: LEGE-CAP-FERRET, France - Famous as a summer getaway for the likes of French actors Marion Cotillard and Jean Dujardin, the Cap Ferret peninsula has turned into a disaster zone due to wildfires, with more than 35,000 people evacuated by road and sea.
